constants_used.hypothetical.reference_request.user_text: Here is our Q3 report and a photo of last week's whiteboard plan. Using our pricing policy, check the current list prices of our three main competitors, compute our gross margin at each of their price points, and plot it. Cite your sources.

description: Great-circle distances (V-005), fiber delay lower bounds, round trips per connection path, edge and reuse savings, failover penalty, flow-control and slow-start bounds, and the illustrative request envelope for the Nairobi reference user.

conventions.class: Distances and fiber delays are physics on hypothetical coordinates (class C inputs). RTT counts are class A (derived from the RFC message flows).
conventions.lower_bound: Every fiber delay is a lower bound: real cable paths are longer than the great circle and routers, amplifiers and queues add delay. No sourced route factor exists, so none is applied.

fiber_speed_check.note: The constant 204,220 km/s is c / 1.468 rounded; the difference is below 0.001%.

conventions.rtt_model: RTT(user→PoP) is hypothetical; RTT(PoP→region) is the great-circle fiber RTT; RTT(user→region without an edge) is their sum.

tcp_tls13_resumed.label: TCP + TLS 1.3 resumed (PSK, no early data)

reuse_saving.note: The reference request uses an already-open HTTP/3 connection to the PoP (reference architecture §12 step 2).

ttft_network_floor.scope: Network part of TTFT only: request out and first token back, zero server time, no loss, DNS cached. Every later token arrives with the same one-way offset, so the gap between tokens is unchanged.

failover.scenario: The nearest region (ap_south) is saturated. Global traffic management sends new requests to the next healthy region (eu_west). The client connection still ends at the Nairobi PoP; only the backbone leg changes.

home_region_round_trip.note: Each synchronous call from the failover region back to data homed in the nearest region (for example a conversation-database write) adds this RTT.

failover.class: C (hypothetical regions and PoP); fiber lower bounds

detour_example.label: illustrative (a hypothetical policy path, not a measured route)

ttft_timer_reference_request.note: Zero processing time: these are network floors, not predictions of TTFT.

k8s_readiness_default_detection.note: Approximate time for a dead pod to fail enough probes with the default settings; EndpointSlice and proxy propagation come on top (no measured figure).

quic_amplification.note: Until the server validates the client's address, it sends at most this many bytes per 1,200-byte client Initial. A larger first flight (long certificate chain) waits one more RTT.

photo_rounds_at_initial_window.note: If the receiver never raised the window (it does, with WINDOW_UPDATE).

slow_start_uploads.model: Ideal slow start: the window doubles every RTT; no loss; flow-control windows never bind. Round k sends iw · 2^(k−1) bytes, so k rounds send iw · (2^k − 1).
